title: my cfd broker was on the other side of my trade the whole time. took me too long to figure that out
author: Immortal_Combat951
selftext:
ran a systematic copper strategy on a cfd broker for about 2 months . the results were kinda decent but the fills kep t coming in slightly worse than the backtest suggested . consistently off by enough to notice .

looked into it nd the broker is b-book . means they are the counterparty . they ll lose when i win . coz they control the pricing infra they can widen spreads on accounts that are performing . no way i cud find to verify it from outside . no way to audit what happened at execution vs what the platform performed

read about it , and found a platform where counterparty is the olp not the broker . pricing is derived from tradfi markets not from someone on the other side with a pnl incentive . the spread is same for every trader and no account getting deprioritized coz the strategy is working .

swithed the strategy over . the fills started matching the backtest more closely that told me most of what i needed to know.
